topic: Updating model deployment access and scripts
summary_markdown: The team discussed updates regarding accessing resources for deploying models. Specifically, it was noted that AWS access is no longer required to upload models to the S3 Bucket; users should now log in via a specific internal URL using AllUnite credentials. Additionally, local job runs (for traffic and impression jobs) no longer require `aws-mfa` when running locally. The necessary updates have been merged into both staging and master branches.
decisions: AWS access is no longer required for S3 model uploads; use the internal login portal instead.
